messages:
rachel (People Ops): Heads-up: new hire (Ethan Park) joins Mon 05/13. Drafting a compact 'first-week kickstart' + manager checklist. Sharing below, please add or react.

diego (Hiring Manager): Nice. Can we make sure he gets briefed on Dedicated & Private deployment customers? Also please include a brief on cost/latency goals so he sees product priorities.

yasmin (ENG Manager): Agree. Suggest blocking a 45-min tech overview (architecture + runtime constraints) and a short runbook walkthrough for releases.

ash (IT): I'll queue device order and create accounts. Need preferred OS, docking needs, and estimated office days. I'll also add him to SSO groups once HR confirms employee ID.

onboard-bot: New hire workflow started: Welcome packet sent, basic trainings queued. Auto-task: "Manager onboarding checklist" assigned to diego.

zoe (Buddy): I'll reach out to Ethan tonight and set a 20-min coffee chat on Day 1. Happy to do daily check-ins morning 10-10:30 for the first 3 days.

rachel (People Ops): Proposed compact agenda (goal: reduce cognitive load, make first week practical):
- Pre-day (Thu/Fri before start): laptop shipped, Okta invite, GitHub org invite, calendar blocks created (team intro, tech overview, 1:1), buddy DM.
- Day 1: 30m People Ops orientation (pay/benefits + org chart), 45m team intro + meet-the-owners, 20m buddy coffee, 30m hiring manager kickoff (expectations + immediate priorities).
- Day 2: 45m architecture & runtime overview (Eng Manager), 30m infra access & Redwood Console demo, 30m provisioning (repos, tickets, SSO).
- Day 3: 60m hands-on: local dev env + sample task, 30m security & compliance quickstart, 30m customer context session (shadow + backlog).
- Day 4: 30m release/runbook walkthrough, 60m paired work on an onboarding ticket, 30m feedback sync with manager.
- Day 5: 60m co-write 30/60/90 draft, 30m ops/infra alignment, 30m People Ops wrap + retro.

Quick owner checklist (one-liners):
- IT (ash): device, SSO, GitHub, VPN. Ticket: IT-ONB-1712.
- Hiring Manager (diego): schedule manager 1:1 cadence, provide the first project and top 3 success metrics.
- Buddy (zoe): welcome DM, daily quick syncs days 1-3, culture tour.
- People Ops (rachel): send offer paperwork, benefits orientation, payroll confirmation, add to staff channels.
- Security: ensure MFA & manager security course assigned before day 3.

30/60/90 skeleton (shareable, fill during week 1):
```
30-day: Immerse in product and team processes. Complete local dev setup, ship first small bugfix or docs improvement. Share observations.
60-day: Take ownership of a minor feature or operational area. Begin improving onboarding flows or a perf/cost metric.
90-day: Deliver end-to-end outcome aligned to team OKRs (e.g., reduce inference tail latency by X% or improve onboarding time by Y%).
```

diego (Hiring Manager): Please add a customer-shadowing 45-min slot (Day 3 preferred). Also, confirm whether Ethan will require access to any private customer repos (I will list them).

yasmin (ENG Manager): If Ethan will work on private deployments, schedule compliance & handling training early. We'll also need him added to the private-deploy group for logs access.

ash (IT): Noted. If manager needs HSM/KMS console access, require signed access form. I'll include that in IT ticket.

zoe (Buddy): I'll prepare a 30-min "how we run inference" primer and a short checklist for local dev. Planning to pin it in #team-onboarding.

rachel (People Ops): Final asks for diego today: 1) confirm start date/time & timezone, 2) provide laptop OS preference + shipping address, 3) list top 2 customers or accounts for shadowing. Once I have those, I'll finalize invites and push the learning bundle. Thanks all :clap:
